unpack_menu_names.USE_LOCAL: Use files in current directory (create when necessary)
unpack_menu_names.WRITE_LOCAL: Write files to current directory (overwrite existing files)
unpack_menu_names.USE_ORIGINAL: Use files in original location (create when necessary)
unpack_menu_names.WRITE_ORIGINAL: Write files to original location (overwrite existing files)
unpack_menu_names.KEEP: Disable auto-pack, keep all packed files
